prerequisites: General theorems of mechanics (fundamental relation of dynamics, kinetic energy theorem, angular momentum theorem…)
syllabus_topics: Recap of free harmonic oscillators and damped oscillators
Study of forced oscillations and resonance phenomena
Notion of impedance and energetic aspects
Coupled oscillators with two degrees of freedom: normal modes of vibration, modal resolution
Generalization to a system of n oscillators
Study of examples of non-linear oscillators
From oscillators to the wave equation
bibliography: J.-P. Pérez, Mécanique - Fondements et applications, Masson, 2001
L. Bocquet, J.-P. Faroux et J. Renault, Toute la Mécanique - Cours et exercices corrigés, Dunod, 2002
J-M. Brébec et al, Ondes, 2 nde année PC-PC*, PSI-PSI*, Collection H-Prépa, Hachette Supérieur, 1997 ou 2004
degree: Licence Sciences pour l'Ingénieur - parcours Mécanique (L3)
